claim.claim-text: 1. A method of isolating one or more of: exosomes, globulins, fibrinogen, and albumin from a tissue source, the method comprising:

2. A method as claimed in claim 1, wherein about 80% to about 95% of the exosomes from the tissue source are isolated, optionally wherein about 90% of the exosomes from the tissue source are isolated.

3. A method as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein in step (iv) the first centrifuge tube is cooled under conditions such that globulins in the plasma filtrate crosslink fibrinogen, exosomes partition into PEG, and the precipitating reagent precipitates CPD.

4. A method as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein in step (v), the first centrifuge tube is centrifuged at a speed in the range of about 1000 to about 5000 revolutions per minute (RPM) for a time period in the range of about 5 minutes to about 30 minutes.

5. A method as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the tissue source is selected from the group consisting of UCB, umbilical cord, umbilical cord lining, umbilical cord stroma cells (Wharton's jelly), amniotic fluid, amniotic membranes, placenta, and peripheral blood.
6. A method of producing exosome-rich plasma (ERP), the method comprising adding plasma or a saline solution to an exosome pellet obtained according to the method of any preceding claim.

7. Exosomes isolatable by the method of any of claims 1 to 5, for use in a method for regenerating a tissue in a subject, optionally wherein the subject is a human suffering from at least one disorder selected from the group consisting of: tissue damage, brain degeneration, central nervous system degeneration, and cardiovascular degeneration; or for use in a method for treating hypoxia, ischemia, or stroke.

8. ERP obtainable by the method of claim 6, for use in a method for treating dry-eye syndrome, an orthopedic disorder, or a dental disorder in a subject, or for use in a method for stimulating uterine vascularization which method comprises administering said ERP to the subject's uterine cavity.
9. A method as claimed in any of claims 1 to 5 further comprising the following steps:
10. The method of claim 9, wherein exosomes, fibrinogen, and albumin, are isolated.
11. The method of claim 9 or claim 10, wherein the precipitating agent is CaCl<2>.

12. A method of culturing mammalian cells, comprising: culturing a population of mammalian cells in a culture medium comprising the exosomes and/or the albumin isolatable by the method of any of claims 1 to 5 or 9 to 11, optionally wherein the population of mammalian cells are human cells.
13. A cell culture medium comprising the exosomes, and/or the fibrinogen, and/or the albumin isolatable by the method of any of claims 1 to 5 or 9 to 11.
14. A pharmaceutical composition comprising the exosomes, fibrinogen, and/or the albumin isolated by the method of any of claims 1 to 5 or 9 to 11, or the ERP produced by the method of claim 6.
15. Fibrinogen isolatable by the method of any one of claims 9 to 11 for use in a method for treating fibrinogenemia or a clotting deficiency.
